title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood
source: Fullmetal Alchemist manga by Hiromu Arakawa (108 chapters), as adapted by Brotherhood, including the epilogue.
world: In the military nation of Amestris, brothers Edward and Alphonse Elric try to bring their dead mother back with alchemy. Ed loses his left leg and Al his whole body; Ed gives his right arm to bind Al's soul to a suit of armour. Ed becomes the State Alchemist called the Fullmetal Alchemist and the brothers search for the Philosopher's Stone, uncovering a conspiracy by the Homunculi and Father. Heart, humour and big ideas about sacrifice.
power_system: Alchemy follows Equivalent Exchange: to gain something, something of equal value must be lost. Alchemists draw transmutation circles; those who have seen the Truth can clap their hands instead. Human transmutation is forbidden. Alkahestry is the eastern country Xing's version. Automail is mechanical prosthetics.

timeline.summary: The brothers lose their bodies trying to revive their mother Trisha.
Ed becomes a State Alchemist; Lab 5; Maes Hughes dies.
The plot of Father and the government is uncovered.
Father is defeated; Ed trades his alchemy to bring back Al's body.
Two years later Ed travels west and Al east to learn alkahestry; Ed and Winry later marry.
